resources.string: Swipe right in the conversation area of the Claude app to open its sidebar. While Claude is on screen, this service uses touch exploration mode to watch for the swipe and presses the menu button for you. Other apps are not affected. This app has no internet permission and does not collect or send any data.
Swipe right in Claude\'s conversation area to open the sidebar.

Turn it on in Accessibility → Installed apps → \"%1$s\".\n\nIf the switch is greyed out (\"Restricted setting\"), open this app\'s App info, tap ⋮ in the top right and choose \"Allow restricted settings\" first.
Show the swipe area on Claude\'s screen
Changes apply immediately. Use split screen with Claude to watch the area while you adjust it.
Swipes starting between the left edge and this point are handled. The rest of the screen always goes straight to Claude.
Keeps a strip at the left edge free for edge gestures such as One Hand Operation+.
Distance from the bottom of the menu button.
Distance from the top of the message box.
This app reads the layout of the Claude app only to find the menu button and the message box. It has no internet permission, so nothing on your screen can leave your device.
Unofficial app. Not affiliated with or endorsed by Anthropic. \"Claude\" is a trademark of Anthropic.
